description: Who talks to whom, from the durable Goldmane edge trail (ADR-0014). Filterable by workload, namespace and port, with an unusual-connections panel over first-seen edges.

options.content:
### What this shows, and what it cannot

Every row is one **durable edge** the `goldmane-edge-aggregator` has observed:
a source workload talking to a destination workload on a destination port, with
the policy action Calico applied. Source: the `edge` table in the
`goldmane_edges` CNPG database.

**Honest limits, worth knowing before you read a number:**

- **There is no time series.** The table keeps `first_seen`, `last_seen` and a
  cumulative `flow_count` per edge, not per-interval counts. So the time picker
  filters on `last_seen` — *"edges last observed inside this window"* — and
  `flows` is a running total since the edge was first seen, never a rate.
- **A port carries no protocol.** `dst_port` alone cannot tell TCP/53 from
  UDP/53.
- **Traffic is per workload, not per pod.** Pod names churn on every restart;
  [Whisker](https://whisker.viktorbarzin.me) is the live per-pod view.
- **No peer addresses.** Goldmane's wire format has no IP field, so an internet
  edge is `pub`, never a destination address.
- **Rows written before the widening migration are not shown.** Those rows are
  NULL in every widened column (no workload, no endpoint type, no port), so
  every panel here filters on `NOT pre_widening`. They are not deleted and the
  `homelab edges` CLI still rolls them up at namespace level — they just cannot
  be plotted on these axes. On the live table that is 4 rows holding 366M
  accumulated flows against 22M observed since, so including them would swamp
  every total.
- **Everything looks new for one window after the migration.** The identity
  tuple is wider, so the first observation of a namespace pair INSERTs a fresh
  row rather than updating the legacy one, and the *Unusual connections* panel
  will be full for the first day. Give it a burn-in before trusting it.

panels.title: Edges in view
panels.description: Edges matching every filter whose last_seen falls in the dashboard time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND (src_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (src_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND dst_port::text = ANY(ARRAY[${port:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND action = ANY(ARRAY[${action:sqlstring}]::text[])

panels.title: Denied
panels.description: Edges Calico denied. Ignores the Action filter on purpose.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND (src_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (src_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND dst_port::text = ANY(ARRAY[${port:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND action = 'deny'

panels.title: Source workloads
panels.description: Distinct source workload names in view.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT src_workload) AS value FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND (src_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (src_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND dst_port::text = ANY(ARRAY[${port:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND action = ANY(ARRAY[${action:sqlstring}]::text[])

SELECT count(DISTINCT dst_port) AS value FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND (src_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (src_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND dst_port::text = ANY(ARRAY[${port:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND action = ANY(ARRAY[${action:sqlstring}]::text[])

panels.title: Internet-bound
panels.description: Edges leaving the cluster. Goldmane names the far end 'pub' and carries no address.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND (src_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (src_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND dst_port::text = ANY(ARRAY[${port:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND action = ANY(ARRAY[${action:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND dst_type = 'network' AND dst_workload = 'pub'

panels.title: First seen in $unusual_window
panels.description: Edges whose first_seen falls inside the Unusual window. Not time-picker scoped.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening AND first_seen >= now() - interval '${unusual_window}' AND (src_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (src_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND action = ANY(ARRAY[${action:sqlstring}]::text[])

panels.title: All traffic
panels.description: Every edge matching the filters, busiest first. Capped at 2000 rows. Column headers are filterable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT src_ns AS "src ns", src_workload AS "src workload", src_type AS "src type", dst_ns AS "dst ns", dst_workload AS "dst workload", dst_type AS "dst type", dst_port AS "port", NULLIF(dst_service, '-') AS "dst service", action, flow_count AS "flows", first_seen AS "first seen", last_seen AS "last seen" FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND (src_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (src_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND dst_port::text = ANY(ARRAY[${port:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND action = ANY(ARRAY[${action:sqlstring}]::text[]) ORDER BY flow_count DESC LIMIT 2000

panels.title: Namespace to namespace
panels.description: Flow volume between namespaces. Destination nodes carry a '-> ' prefix so a pair that talks both ways does not form a cycle the diagram cannot draw. An end with no namespace is labelled by its endpoint type and name ('host k8s-node1', 'networkset cloudflare-edge'); 'pub' reads as 'internet'. Top 60 pairs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN src_ns <> '-' THEN src_ns WHEN src_workload = 'pub' THEN 'internet' ELSE src_type || ' ' || src_workload END AS source, '-> ' || CASE WHEN dst_ns <> '-' THEN dst_ns WHEN dst_workload = 'pub' THEN 'internet' ELSE dst_type || ' ' || dst_workload END AS target, SUM(flow_count) AS value FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND (src_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (src_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND dst_port::text = ANY(ARRAY[${port:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND action = ANY(ARRAY[${action:sqlstring}]::text[]) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING SUM(flow_count) > 0 ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 60

panels.title: Busiest destination ports
panels.description: Cumulative flow count per destination port. No protocol is recorded, so TCP and UDP on the same port are one bar. Top 15.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dst_port::text AS port, SUM(flow_count) AS flows FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND (src_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (src_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND dst_port::text = ANY(ARRAY[${port:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND action = ANY(ARRAY[${action:sqlstring}]::text[]) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY flows DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Busiest source workloads
panels.description: Cumulative flow count per source workload. Top 12 — the ns/workload labels need the room.

targets.rawSql: SELECT src_ns || '/' || src_workload AS workload, SUM(flow_count) AS flows FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND (src_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (src_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND dst_port::text = ANY(ARRAY[${port:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND action = ANY(ARRAY[${action:sqlstring}]::text[]) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY flows DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Unusual connections
panels.description: Three classes, most specific reason first: a namespace reaching the internet for the first time, a workload using a destination port it has never used, and any edge first seen inside the window. Every row is at least a new edge, so 'why' can name more than one class. The Port filter is deliberately NOT applied here, or a leftover port selection would hide the new ports this panel exists to surface. Window is the 'Unusual window' variable, independent of the time picker. Every row is a new edge; 'why' names the most specific class that applies.

targets.rawSql:
WITH win AS (
  SELECT (now() - interval '${unusual_window}') AS since
), fresh AS (
  SELECT e.* FROM edge e CROSS JOIN win w
  WHERE NOT e.pre_widening
    AND e.first_seen >= w.since
    AND (src_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    AND (src_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    AND action = ANY(ARRAY[${action:sqlstring}]::text[])
)
SELECT
  f.first_seen AS "first seen",
  -- Most specific reason wins. Every row here is a new edge by construction
  -- (first_seen inside the window), so naming that as well on rows with a
  -- sharper reason just makes the column unreadable.
  COALESCE(
    CASE WHEN f.dst_type = 'network' AND f.dst_workload = 'pub' AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM edge p CROSS JOIN win w
           WHERE NOT p.pre_widening AND p.src_ns = f.src_ns AND p.dst_type = 'network' AND p.dst_workload = 'pub'
             AND p.first_seen < w.since)
         THEN 'first internet egress for this namespace' END,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM edge p CROSS JOIN win w
           WHERE NOT p.pre_widening AND p.src_ns = f.src_ns AND p.src_workload = f.src_workload AND p.first_seen < w.since)
         AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM edge p CROSS JOIN win w
           WHERE NOT p.pre_widening AND p.src_ns = f.src_ns AND p.src_workload = f.src_workload AND p.dst_port = f.dst_port
             AND p.first_seen < w.since)
         THEN 'port new to this workload' END,
    'new edge') AS "why",
  f.src_ns AS "src ns", f.src_workload AS "src workload",
  f.dst_ns AS "dst ns", f.dst_workload AS "dst workload", f.dst_type AS "dst type",
  f.dst_port AS "port", NULLIF(f.dst_service, '-') AS "dst service",
  f.action, f.flow_count AS "flows"
FROM fresh f
ORDER BY f.first_seen DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Denied edges
panels.description: Edges Calico denied, most recently seen first. Ignores the Action filter on purpose.

targets.rawSql: SELECT src_ns AS "src ns", src_workload AS "src workload", src_type AS "src type", dst_ns AS "dst ns", dst_workload AS "dst workload", dst_type AS "dst type", dst_port AS "port", NULLIF(dst_service, '-') AS "dst service", action, flow_count AS "flows", first_seen AS "first seen", last_seen AS "last seen" FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND (src_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (src_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND dst_port::text = ANY(ARRAY[${port:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND action = 'deny' ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Ends with no workload (host and internet traffic)
panels.description: Edges where neither end is typed as a pod: a host endpoint, a network set, the public internet, or an end whose type Goldmane never sent ('unknown'). These carry namespace '-'. Before the widening the endpoint type was not stored at all, so this class could not be separated out; host-to-host rows were also dropped by the old same-namespace test, which matched two ends that both reported '-'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT src_ns AS "src ns", src_workload AS "src workload", src_type AS "src type", dst_ns AS "dst ns", dst_workload AS "dst workload", dst_type AS "dst type", dst_port AS "port", NULLIF(dst_service, '-') AS "dst service", action, flow_count AS "flows", first_seen AS "first seen", last_seen AS "last seen" FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND (src_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (src_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR dst_workload = ANY(ARRAY[${workload:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND dst_port::text = ANY(ARRAY[${port:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND action = ANY(ARRAY[${action:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND (src_type <> 'workload' OR dst_type <> 'workload') ORDER BY flow_count DESC LIMIT 200

list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: Matches either end of the edge. '-' is Goldmane's marker for an end with no namespace (a host endpoint, a network set, or the internet).
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT src_ns FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening UNION SELECT DISTINCT dst_ns FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT src_ns FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening UNION SELECT DISTINCT dst_ns FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening ORDER BY 1

list.name: workload
list.label: Workload
list.description: Matches either end. Scoped to the selected namespaces.
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT src_workload FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening AND src_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) UNION SELECT DISTINCT dst_workload FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening AND dst_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT src_workload FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening AND src_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) UNION SELECT DISTINCT dst_workload FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening AND dst_ns = ANY(ARRAY[${namespace:sqlstring}]::text[]) ORDER BY 1

list.name: port
list.label: Destination port
list.description: Destination port. No protocol is recorded, so one entry covers TCP and UDP.
list.definition: SELECT dst_port::text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT dst_port FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening ORDER BY dst_port) t
list.query: SELECT dst_port::text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT dst_port FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening ORDER BY dst_port) t

list.name: action
list.label: Action
list.description: The policy action Calico applied: allow, deny, pass or unspecified.
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT action FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT action FROM edge WHERE NOT pre_widening ORDER BY 1

list.name: unusual_window
list.label: Unusual window
list.description: How far back the Unusual connections panel counts an edge as new. Independent of the time picker.
